# XuTerm

> XuTerm is a free, privacy-first SSH & Mosh terminal client for Android & iOS with native tmux integration, SFTP browser, trzsz file transfer, TOTP two-factor authentication, server monitoring and 20+ built-in DevOps tools. No ads, no subscriptions, no tracking.

- [Privacy Policy (Russian)](https://xuterm.vercel.app/privacy-policy-ru.html): Russian privacy policy
